title: Hundreds of Maltese skulls vanish after the finder dies

tellings.quote: from the Maltese locals that they found [ __ ] hundreds of these skulls. Hundreds of these skulls. Then the guy who finds it mysteriously dies. Someone from like some Smithsonian institute takes over. All those skulls vanish away.

plain: On the island of Malta, hundreds of unusual skulls were found, the man who found them then died mysteriously, someone from the Smithsonian, the big American museum and research institution, took over, and all the skulls vanished. A guest named Jay Anderson repeats this as something he heard from Maltese locals. If true, it would mean strange remains were found and quietly taken out of sight.
